newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Zilveren Kruis signs Boots contract.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Zilveren Kruis signs Boots contract.

text.p: Dutch health insurer Zilveren Kruis said on Thursday that its clients could visit Dutch outlets of British pharmacy group Boots Co Plc for medicine prescriptions.
Zilveren Kruis, unit of unlisted Achmea, said it was signing a contract with Boots today.
Last June Boots opened its first Dutch store, in Rotterdam, and plans to open two further outlets in the southern city of Maastricht and in Breda this year.
Boots said each shop will have a pharmacy and could handle prescription and over the counter medicines sales.
Zilveren Kruis said the contract with Boots will yield the insurer a few percent discount on total costs for medicines.
